notes:
CRM notes / call captures:
- Company: mid-market SaaS (workflow automation for SMBs) building an in-product assistant that can both answer and take actions ('search, then create ticket / schedule / confirm').
- Primary contact: CTO Priya Sharma; product lead: Aaron Cole (PM).
- PoC scope: 2-week Hosted-API POC embedded in staging environment. Validate streaming UX + tool-call choreography (search index fetch -> action API).
- Latency SLOs: first token <300ms typical, streaming chunks <=150ms, end-to-end tool call end-to-end <1.2s for known fast actions. Customer cares about 95th/99th percentile.
- Reliability concerns: tool-call timeouts causing assistant to emit a generic "I couldn't complete that" message. Want automatic retries + idempotency guarantees for actions (create-ticket, modify-subscription).
- Asked about: partial-stream recovery (if tool call fails mid-stream, can runtime pause and resume?), visibility into per-tool-call latency and error rates, per-route dashboards.
- Security: must support SSO/SAML for admin console, audit logs for all action calls, KMS integration for keys, and data residency in US/EU depending on tenant.
- Pricing sensitivity: mid-market — wants hosted initially to move fast, but Dedicated attractive if unit economics predictable at 1000+ daily active assistants.
- Quote from CTO: 'We need an assistant that can take action reliably. A single failed ticket creation breaks trust.'
- Internal notes: product wants streaming + tool-calling sample integrated into their web client by next sprint. Engineering requests SDK examples for streaming tool-call hooks, guidance on retry/backoff semantics and idempotency keys.
- Risks: if Hosted API cannot meet tail latency during tool-heavy flows, they will push for Dedicated — must produce benchmark numbers during POC.
- Next step: run extended POC test that exercises tool-call timeouts, measure recovery patterns, capture per-call telemetry (SE to provide test script).
technical_requirements:
SLOs & integration details:
- Streaming: support chunked responses and client-side stitching; ability to flush partial results while tool call pending.
- Tool calls: synchronous and async patterns supported; require retryable call wrappers and idempotency-key guidance.
- Observability: per-request trace id, per-tool-call latency/error metrics surfaced in Console.
- Routing: policy to prefer hosted region (us-east) with fallback to dedicated pool; want canary deploys for model updates.
- Rate/throughput: expected POC throughput ~150 concurrent agent sessions, production target 1k+ concurrent.
- Data handling: ephemeral KV cache allowed; persistent logs must be exportable to their SIEM.
poc_plan: Phase 1 (2 weeks Hosted API): embed agent in staging, streaming UI, test 3 tool integrations (search, ticket-create, calendar scheduling), run scripted timeout experiments. Phase 2 (2 weeks): compare with small Dedicated pool using same traffic profile; collect p95/p99 latencies, error modes, and cost estimates. Deliverable: benchmark doc + recommended config (batching, quant profiles).
commercial_notes: Customer prefers self-serve Hosted to start. Procurement will consider Dedicated if p99 latency and cost per DAU are predictable. Finance asked for 12-month Dedicated pricing band. SE to loop in pricing ops for a proposal.
closing_signals: positive POC results on tool-call reliability; legal OK on residency/KMS; Dedicated price within estimated ARR band
